components.name: Roblox Luau Quest & Objective Tracker
components.description: Typed Roblox Luau ModuleScript service for tracking per-player quest states, incrementing objective counters, and emitting completion rewards cleanly on the server.

preview.caption: Roblox Luau server module — store QuestConfig in ReplicatedStorage/Quests/QuestConfig and QuestService in ServerScriptService/Quests/QuestService.
architecture: QuestService.AcceptQuest(userId, questId) & RecordProgress(userId, objectiveType, delta, onCompleted)
preview.projectRef: Place QuestConfig.luau as a ModuleScript at ReplicatedStorage/Quests/QuestConfig and QuestService.luau as a ModuleScript at ServerScriptService/Quests/QuestService.

files.label: QuestConfig.luau
QuestService.luau
files.content:
--!strict
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local QuestsFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Quests")
local QuestConfig = require(QuestsFolder:WaitForChild("QuestConfig"))

export type PlayerQuestState = {
	questId: string,
	progress: number,
	completed: boolean,
}

local QuestService = {}
local playerStates: { [number]: { [string]: PlayerQuestState } } = {}

function QuestService.AcceptQuest(userId: number, questId: string): boolean
	local def = QuestConfig[questId]
	if not def then
		return false
	end
	playerStates[userId] = playerStates[userId] or {}
	if playerStates[userId][questId] then
		return false
	end
	playerStates[userId][questId] = {
		questId = questId,
		progress = 0,
		completed = false,
	}
	return true
end

function QuestService.RecordProgress(
	userId: number,
	objectiveType: string,
	delta: number,
	onCompleted: ((userId: number, def: QuestConfig.QuestDefinition) -> ())?
): number
	if delta <= 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local active = playerStates[userId]
	if not active then
		return 0
	end
	local completedNow = 0
	for questId, state in active do
		if state.completed then
			continue
		end
		local def = QuestConfig[questId]
		if def and def.objectiveType == objectiveType then
			state.progress = math.min(def.targetCount, state.progress + delta)
			if state.progress >= def.targetCount then
				state.completed = true
				completedNow += 1
				if onCompleted then
					onCompleted(userId, def)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return completedNow
end

function QuestService.ClearPlayer(userId: number)
	playerStates[userId] = nil
end

return QuestService

components.install: Create a Folder named Quests in ReplicatedStorage with ModuleScript QuestConfig (QuestConfig.luau), and a Folder named Quests in ServerScriptService with ModuleScript QuestService (QuestService.luau).
components.usage: Require ServerScriptService.Quests.QuestService on the server, call QuestService.AcceptQuest(player.UserId, "slime_hunt"), and report progress via QuestService.RecordProgress(player.UserId, "defeat_slime", 1, onCompleted).

files.content:
# file-helpers - Otter Reusable File & Storage Library
# Provides readOrFallback, writeSafe, appendSafe, deleteFileSafe, fileExistsSafe,
# toJsonSafe, fromJsonSafe, readJsonObject, readJsonObjectSafe, and writeJsonObject
# Internal variables use '_fh_' prefix to prevent collisions with caller/outer variables.

to fileExistsSafe filePath
    if file filePath exists
        return true
    .
    return false
.

to readOrFallback filePath fallbackValue
    if file filePath exists
        try
            read filePath into _fh_content
            return _fh_content
        otherwise
            return fallbackValue
        .
    .
    return fallbackValue
.

to writeSafe filePath content
    try
        write content to filePath
        return true
    otherwise
        return false
    .
.

to appendSafe filePath content
    try
        append content to filePath
        return true
    otherwise
        return false
    .
.

to deleteFileSafe filePath
    try
        if file filePath exists
            delete file filePath
            return true
        .
    otherwise
        return false
    .
    return false
.

to toJsonSafe obj fallbackValue
    try
        convert obj to json into _fh_raw
        return _fh_raw
    otherwise
        return fallbackValue
    .
.

to fromJsonSafe rawJson fallbackValue
    try
        _fh_target is a thing
        convert rawJson from json into _fh_target
        return _fh_target
    otherwise
        return fallbackValue
    .
.

to readJsonObject filePath
    try
        if file filePath exists
            read filePath into _fh_rawJson
            _fh_target is a thing
            convert _fh_rawJson from json into _fh_target
            return _fh_target
        .
    otherwise
        return gone
    .
    return gone
.

to readJsonObjectSafe filePath fallbackValue
    try
        if file filePath exists
            read filePath into _fh_rawJson
            _fh_target is a thing
            convert _fh_rawJson from json into _fh_target
            return _fh_target
        .
    otherwise
        return fallbackValue
    .
    return fallbackValue
.

to writeJsonObject filePath obj
    try
        convert obj to json into _fh_rawJson
        write _fh_rawJson to filePath
        return true
    otherwise
        return false
    .
.

# Tests for file-helpers (Strict Behavioral Assertions)
use "../src/main.ot"

say "Running file-helpers behavioral tests..."

get system folder "temp" into tempFolder
testTxtFile is tempFolder + "test_helpers_temp.txt"
testJsonFile is tempFolder + "test_helpers_temp.json"

# Clean up before testing
deleteFileSafe testTxtFile
deleteFileSafe testJsonFile

# 1. Missing file returns fallback
m1 is readOrFallback "non_existent_file_12345.txt" "DEFAULT"
if m1 is not "DEFAULT"
    fail with "readOrFallback failed: expected DEFAULT for non-existent file"
.

# 2. fileExistsSafe
if fileExistsSafe "non_existent_file_12345.txt" is not false
    fail with "fileExistsSafe failed: expected false for missing file"
.

# 3. Write and read text
wOk is writeSafe testTxtFile "Initial text content\n"
if wOk is not true
    fail with "writeSafe failed: write returned false"
.
if fileExistsSafe testTxtFile is not true
    fail with "fileExistsSafe failed: expected file to exist after write"
.
readBack is readOrFallback testTxtFile "FAIL"
if readBack is not "Initial text content\n"
    fail with "readOrFallback mismatch after write"
.

# 4. Append text
aOk is appendSafe testTxtFile "Appended second line\n"
if aOk is not true
    fail with "appendSafe failed: append returned false"
.
appendedContent is readOrFallback testTxtFile "FAIL"
if not appendedContent contains "Appended second line"
    fail with "appendSafe failed: content did not contain appended line"
.

# 5. JSON serialization and deserialization
obj has
    title is "Config Settings"
    port is 8080
    debug is true
.
jsonStr is toJsonSafe obj "{}"
if not jsonStr contains "8080"
    fail with "toJsonSafe failed: output missing port 8080"
.

# 6. Corrupt JSON deserialization safeguard
corruptJson is "{ this is invalid json !!!"
fallbackVal has
    fallbackKey is "active"
.
recoveredObj is fromJsonSafe corruptJson fallbackVal
if fallbackKey of recoveredObj is not "active"
    fail with "fromJsonSafe failed: corrupt JSON did not return fallback value"
.

# 7. Write and read JSON file
wJsonOk is writeJsonObject testJsonFile obj
if wJsonOk is not true
    fail with "writeJsonObject failed: returned false"
.
loadedObj is readJsonObject testJsonFile
if title of loadedObj is not "Config Settings"
    fail with "readJsonObject failed: title mismatch"
.
if port of loadedObj is not 8080
    fail with "readJsonObject failed: port mismatch"
.

# 8. Missing JSON file safe read
missingJsonObj is readJsonObjectSafe "does_not_exist.json" fallbackVal
if fallbackKey of missingJsonObj is not "active"
    fail with "readJsonObjectSafe failed: missing file did not return fallback"
.

# 9. Delete files and confirm removal
deleteFileSafe testTxtFile
deleteFileSafe testJsonFile
if fileExistsSafe testTxtFile is not false
    fail with "deleteFileSafe failed: text file still exists"
.
if fileExistsSafe testJsonFile is not false
    fail with "deleteFileSafe failed: json file still exists"
.

say "All file-helpers behavioral tests passed successfully!"

# game-entity - Otter Reusable Game Actor & Combat Library
# Provides Actor, InventoryItem, Cooldown, Inventory, Equipment,
# combat mechanics, leveling, inventory management, and state persistence
# Internal variables use '_ge_' prefix to prevent collisions with caller/outer variables.

a Actor has
    name
    health
    maxHealth
    level
    isAlive
    attackBonus
    defenseBonus
    experience
.

a InventoryItem has
    itemName
    itemKind
    itemPower
    isStackable
    itemCount
    maxStack
.

a Cooldown has
    skillName
    cooldownSeconds
    lastUsedSeconds
.

a Inventory has
    capacity
    currentCount
    items
.

a Equipment has
    weapon
    armor
    accessory
.

to createActor name hp lvl
    _ge_actor is a Actor
    name of _ge_actor is name
    health of _ge_actor is hp
    maxHealth of _ge_actor is hp
    level of _ge_actor is lvl
    isAlive of _ge_actor is true
    attackBonus of _ge_actor is 0
    defenseBonus of _ge_actor is 0
    experience of _ge_actor is 0
    return _ge_actor
.

to createItem itemName itemKind itemPower
    _ge_item is a InventoryItem
    itemName of _ge_item is itemName
    itemKind of _ge_item is itemKind
    itemPower of _ge_item is itemPower
    isStackable of _ge_item is false
    itemCount of _ge_item is 1
    maxStack of _ge_item is 1
    return _ge_item
.

to createStackableItem itemName itemKind itemPower countVal maxStackVal
    _ge_item is a InventoryItem
    itemName of _ge_item is itemName
    itemKind of _ge_item is itemKind
    itemPower of _ge_item is itemPower
    isStackable of _ge_item is true
    itemCount of _ge_item is countVal
    maxStack of _ge_item is maxStackVal
    return _ge_item
.

to applyDamage actor amount
    if amount is at most 0
        return health of actor
    .
    _ge_cur is health of actor
    _ge_newHp is _ge_cur minus amount
    if _ge_newHp is at most 0
        health of actor is 0
        isAlive of actor is false
        return 0
    .
    health of actor is _ge_newHp
    return _ge_newHp
.

to restoreHealth actor amount
    if isAlive of actor is false
        return 0
    .
    _ge_cur is health of actor
    _ge_maxHp is maxHealth of actor
    _ge_newHp is _ge_cur plus amount
    if _ge_newHp is greater than _ge_maxHp
        health of actor is _ge_maxHp
        return _ge_maxHp
    .
    health of actor is _ge_newHp
    return _ge_newHp
.

to reviveActor actor hp
    if hp is at most 0
        return 0
    .
    isAlive of actor is true
    _ge_maxHp is maxHealth of actor
    _ge_newHp is hp
    if _ge_newHp is greater than _ge_maxHp
        _ge_newHp is _ge_maxHp
    .
    health of actor is _ge_newHp
    return _ge_newHp
.

to levelUp actor
    _ge_curLvl is level of actor
    level of actor is _ge_curLvl plus 1
    _ge_curMax is maxHealth of actor
    _ge_newMax is _ge_curMax plus 25
    maxHealth of actor is _ge_newMax
    health of actor is _ge_newMax
    attackBonus of actor is attackBonus of actor plus 5
    defenseBonus of actor is defenseBonus of actor plus 3
    return level of actor
.

to gainExperience actor amount neededPerLevel
    if neededPerLevel is at most 0
        return false
    .
    _ge_curExp is experience of actor
    experience of actor is _ge_curExp plus amount
    _ge_leveled is false
    while experience of actor is at least neededPerLevel
        levelUp actor
        _ge_remExp is experience of actor minus neededPerLevel
        experience of actor is _ge_remExp
        _ge_leveled is true
    .
    return _ge_leveled
.

to createCooldown name cd
    _ge_cdObj is a Cooldown
    skillName of _ge_cdObj is name
    cooldownSeconds of _ge_cdObj is cd
    lastUsedSeconds of _ge_cdObj is 0 minus 9999
    return _ge_cdObj
.

to isCooldownReady cooldownObj nowSeconds
    _ge_last is lastUsedSeconds of cooldownObj
    _ge_dur is cooldownSeconds of cooldownObj
    _ge_elapsed is nowSeconds minus _ge_last
    if _ge_elapsed is at least _ge_dur
        return true
    .
    return false
.

to triggerCooldown cooldownObj nowSeconds
    _ge_check is isCooldownReady cooldownObj nowSeconds
    if _ge_check is true
        lastUsedSeconds of cooldownObj is nowSeconds
        return true
    .
    return false
.

to createInventory slots
    _ge_inv is a Inventory
    capacity of _ge_inv is slots
    currentCount of _ge_inv is 0
    _ge_empty are empty
    items of _ge_inv is _ge_empty
    return _ge_inv
.

to getInventoryCount inv
    return currentCount of inv
.

to getInventoryCapacity inv
    return capacity of inv
.

to findItemInInventory inv targetName
    _ge_itemList is items of inv
    for each _ge_it in _ge_itemList
        if itemName of _ge_it is targetName
            return _ge_it
        .
    .
    return gone
.

to addItemToInventory inv item
    _ge_curCount is currentCount of inv
    _ge_cap is capacity of inv
    
    # Check if stackable with existing item
    if isStackable of item is true
        _ge_existing is findItemInInventory inv itemName of item
        if _ge_existing is not gone
            _ge_existingCount is itemCount of _ge_existing
            _ge_addCount is itemCount of item
            _ge_newCount is _ge_existingCount plus _ge_addCount
            _ge_maxLimit is maxStack of _ge_existing
            if _ge_newCount is at most _ge_maxLimit
                itemCount of _ge_existing is _ge_newCount
                return true
            .
        .
    .

    # Check capacity limit
    if _ge_curCount is at least _ge_cap
        return false
    .

    currentCount of inv is _ge_curCount plus 1
    _ge_itemList is items of inv
    add item to _ge_itemList
    return true
.

to removeItemFromInventory inv targetName
    _ge_itemList is items of inv
    _ge_newItems are empty
    _ge_removed is false
    for each _ge_it in _ge_itemList
        if not _ge_removed and itemName of _ge_it is targetName
            _ge_removed is true
        otherwise
            add _ge_it to _ge_newItems
        .
    .
    if _ge_removed is true
        items of inv is _ge_newItems
        currentCount of inv is currentCount of inv minus 1
        return true
    .
    return false
.

to consumeItemFromInventory inv targetName amount
    if amount is at most 0
        return false
    .
    _ge_targetItem is findItemInInventory inv targetName
    if _ge_targetItem is gone
        return false
    .
    _ge_curQty is itemCount of _ge_targetItem
    if _ge_curQty is less than amount
        return false
    .
    _ge_remQty is _ge_curQty minus amount
    if _ge_remQty is at most 0
        removeItemFromInventory inv targetName
    otherwise
        itemCount of _ge_targetItem is _ge_remQty
    .
    return true
.

to createEquipment
    _ge_newEq is a Equipment
    weapon of _ge_newEq is gone
    armor of _ge_newEq is gone
    accessory of _ge_newEq is gone
    return _ge_newEq
.

to equipItem equipment item
    _ge_kind is itemKind of item
    if _ge_kind is "weapon"
        weapon of equipment is item
        return true
    .
    if _ge_kind is "armor"
        armor of equipment is item
        return true
    .
    if _ge_kind is "accessory"
        accessory of equipment is item
        return true
    .
    if _ge_kind is "attack_accessory"
        accessory of equipment is item
        return true
    .
    if _ge_kind is "defense_accessory"
        accessory of equipment is item
        return true
    .
    return false
.

to unequipSlot equipment slotName
    if slotName is "weapon"
        _ge_prevW is weapon of equipment
        weapon of equipment is gone
        return _ge_prevW
    .
    if slotName is "armor"
        _ge_prevA is armor of equipment
        armor of equipment is gone
        return _ge_prevA
    .
    if slotName is "accessory"
        _ge_prevAcc is accessory of equipment
        accessory of equipment is gone
        return _ge_prevAcc
    .
    return gone
.

to getEquipmentAttackBonus equipment
    _ge_bonus is 0
    _ge_w is weapon of equipment
    if _ge_w is not gone
        _ge_bonus is _ge_bonus plus itemPower of _ge_w
    .
    _ge_acc is accessory of equipment
    if _ge_acc is not gone
        _ge_k is itemKind of _ge_acc
        if _ge_k is "attack_accessory"
            _ge_bonus is _ge_bonus plus itemPower of _ge_acc
        otherwise if _ge_k is "accessory"
            _ge_bonus is _ge_bonus plus itemPower of _ge_acc
        .
    .
    return _ge_bonus
.

to getEquipmentDefenseBonus equipment
    _ge_bonus is 0
    _ge_arm is armor of equipment
    if _ge_arm is not gone
        _ge_bonus is _ge_bonus plus itemPower of _ge_arm
    .
    _ge_acc is accessory of equipment
    if _ge_acc is not gone
        _ge_k is itemKind of _ge_acc
        if _ge_k is "defense_accessory"
            _ge_bonus is _ge_bonus plus itemPower of _ge_acc
        .
    .
    return _ge_bonus
.

to buildItemRecord it
    _ge_itemData has
        itemName is itemName of it
        itemKind is itemKind of it
        itemPower is itemPower of it
        isStackable is isStackable of it
        itemCount is itemCount of it
        maxStack is maxStack of it
    .
    return _ge_itemData
.

to serializeGameState actor inv equip
    _ge_rawItems are empty
    for each _ge_it in items of inv
        _ge_rec is buildItemRecord _ge_it
        add _ge_rec to _ge_rawItems
    .

    _ge_equipData has
        hasWeapon is false
        hasArmor is false
        hasAccessory is false
    .
    _ge_w is weapon of equip
    if _ge_w is not gone
        hasWeapon of _ge_equipData is true
        weaponName of _ge_equipData is itemName of _ge_w
        weaponPower of _ge_equipData is itemPower of _ge_w
    .
    _ge_arm is armor of equip
    if _ge_arm is not gone
        hasArmor of _ge_equipData is true
        armorName of _ge_equipData is itemName of _ge_arm
        armorPower of _ge_equipData is itemPower of _ge_arm
    .
    _ge_acc is accessory of equip
    if _ge_acc is not gone
        hasAccessory of _ge_equipData is true
        accessoryName of _ge_equipData is itemName of _ge_acc
        accessoryKind of _ge_equipData is itemKind of _ge_acc
        accessoryPower of _ge_equipData is itemPower of _ge_acc
    .

    _ge_gameState has
        name is name of actor
        health is health of actor
        maxHealth is maxHealth of actor
        level is level of actor
        isAlive is isAlive of actor
        attackBonus is attackBonus of actor
        defenseBonus is defenseBonus of actor
        experience is experience of actor
        inventoryCapacity is capacity of inv
        inventoryCount is currentCount of inv
        inventoryItems is _ge_rawItems
        equipment is _ge_equipData
    .
    return _ge_gameState
.

to deserializeGameState stateData
    # 1. Reconstruct Actor
    _ge_restoredAct is createActor name of stateData health of stateData level of stateData
    maxHealth of _ge_restoredAct is maxHealth of stateData
    isAlive of _ge_restoredAct is isAlive of stateData
    attackBonus of _ge_restoredAct is attackBonus of stateData
    defenseBonus of _ge_restoredAct is defenseBonus of stateData
    experience of _ge_restoredAct is experience of stateData

    # 2. Reconstruct Inventory
    _ge_restoredInv is createInventory inventoryCapacity of stateData
    for each _ge_rawIt in inventoryItems of stateData
        _ge_it is createItem itemName of _ge_rawIt itemKind of _ge_rawIt itemPower of _ge_rawIt
        isStackable of _ge_it is isStackable of _ge_rawIt
        itemCount of _ge_it is itemCount of _ge_rawIt
        maxStack of _ge_it is maxStack of _ge_rawIt
        addItemToInventory _ge_restoredInv _ge_it
    .

    # 3. Reconstruct Equipment
    _ge_restoredEq is createEquipment
    _ge_eqData is equipment of stateData
    if hasWeapon of _ge_eqData is true
        _ge_wItem is createItem weaponName of _ge_eqData "weapon" weaponPower of _ge_eqData
        equipItem _ge_restoredEq _ge_wItem
    .
    if hasArmor of _ge_eqData is true
        _ge_aItem is createItem armorName of _ge_eqData "armor" armorPower of _ge_eqData
        equipItem _ge_restoredEq _ge_aItem
    .
    if hasAccessory of _ge_eqData is true
        _ge_accObj is createItem accessoryName of _ge_eqData accessoryKind of _ge_eqData accessoryPower of _ge_eqData
        equipItem _ge_restoredEq _ge_accObj
    .

    _ge_bundle has
        actor is _ge_restoredAct
        inventory is _ge_restoredInv
        equipment is _ge_restoredEq
    .
    return _ge_bundle
.

# Tests for game-entity (Strict Behavioral Assertions)
use "../src/main.ot"

say "Running game-entity behavioral tests..."

# 1. Actor creation
hero is createActor "Sir Galahad" 100 1
if name of hero is not "Sir Galahad"
    fail with "createActor failed: name mismatch"
.
if health of hero is not 100
    fail with "createActor failed: health mismatch"
.
if isAlive of hero is not true
    fail with "createActor failed: expected isAlive to be true"
.

# 2. Damage & Death State
applyDamage hero 40
if health of hero is not 60
    fail with "applyDamage failed: expected 60 HP"
.
applyDamage hero 70
if health of hero is not 0
    fail with "applyDamage death failed: expected 0 HP"
.
if isAlive of hero is not false
    fail with "applyDamage death failed: expected isAlive to be false"
.

# 3. Dead Actor cannot be healed without revive
healedDead is restoreHealth hero 50
if healedDead is not 0
    fail with "restoreHealth failed: dead actor was healed"
.
if isAlive of hero is not false
    fail with "dead actor was unexpectedly revived by restoreHealth"
.

# 4. Revive Actor & Healing Cap
reviveActor hero 20
if isAlive of hero is not true
    fail with "reviveActor failed: expected isAlive to be true"
.
if health of hero is not 20
    fail with "reviveActor failed: expected 20 HP"
.
restoreHealth hero 200
if health of hero is not 100
    fail with "restoreHealth cap failed: health exceeded maxHealth 100"
.

# 5. Experience & Leveling
leveledUp is gainExperience hero 150 100
if leveledUp is not true
    fail with "gainExperience failed: expected level-up to trigger"
.
if level of hero is not 2
    fail with "levelUp failed: expected level 2"
.
if maxHealth of hero is not 125
    fail with "levelUp failed: expected maxHealth 125"
.
if attackBonus of hero is not 5
    fail with "levelUp failed: expected attackBonus 5"
.
if defenseBonus of hero is not 3
    fail with "levelUp failed: expected defenseBonus 3"
.
if experience of hero is not 50
    fail with "gainExperience failed: expected 50 remaining experience"
.

# 6. Cooldowns
slashCd is createCooldown "Slash" 3
if isCooldownReady slashCd 10 is not true
    fail with "isCooldownReady initial check failed"
.
triggerCooldown slashCd 10
if isCooldownReady slashCd 11 is not false
    fail with "isCooldownReady check after 1s failed: should be cooling down"
.
if isCooldownReady slashCd 13 is not true
    fail with "isCooldownReady check after 3s failed: should be ready"
.

# 7. Inventory & Capacity
bag is createInventory 2
potion1 is createItem "Health Potion" "consumable" 25
potion2 is createItem "Mana Potion" "consumable" 15
swordItem is createItem "Broadsword" "weapon" 12

ok1 is addItemToInventory bag potion1
if ok1 is not true
    fail with "addItemToInventory 1 failed"
.
ok2 is addItemToInventory bag potion2
if ok2 is not true
    fail with "addItemToInventory 2 failed"
.
# Exceeds capacity
ok3 is addItemToInventory bag swordItem
if ok3 is not false
    fail with "addItemToInventory should fail when capacity is full"
.
if getInventoryCount bag is not 2
    fail with "getInventoryCount mismatch"
.

# 8. Find and Remove Items
foundPot is findItemInInventory bag "Health Potion"
if foundPot is gone
    fail with "findItemInInventory failed to find item"
.
remOk is removeItemFromInventory bag "Health Potion"
if remOk is not true
    fail with "removeItemFromInventory failed to remove item"
.
if getInventoryCount bag is not 1
    fail with "getInventoryCount mismatch after removal"
.
missingPot is findItemInInventory bag "Health Potion"
if missingPot is not gone
    fail with "removed item is still found in inventory"
.

# 9. Stackable Items
arrow1 is createStackableItem "Iron Arrow" "ammo" 1 10 30
arrow2 is createStackableItem "Iron Arrow" "ammo" 1 15 30
addItemToInventory bag arrow1
addItemToInventory bag arrow2
stackedArrow is findItemInInventory bag "Iron Arrow"
if itemCount of stackedArrow is not 25
    fail with "stackable item failed: expected stacked count 25"
.

# 10. Equipment System & Stat Bonuses
equip is createEquipment
weaponItem is createItem "Excalibur" "weapon" 20
armorItem is createItem "Dragon Plate" "armor" 15
equipItem equip weaponItem
equipItem equip armorItem

atkBonus is getEquipmentAttackBonus equip
if atkBonus is not 20
    fail with "getEquipmentAttackBonus failed: expected 20"
.
defBonus is getEquipmentDefenseBonus equip
if defBonus is not 15
    fail with "getEquipmentDefenseBonus failed: expected 15"
.

# 11. State Serialization & Deserialization
savedState is serializeGameState hero bag equip
if name of savedState is not "Sir Galahad"
    fail with "serializeGameState failed: name mismatch"
.

# Restore into fresh objects
restoredBundle is deserializeGameState savedState
restoredHero is actor of restoredBundle
restoredBag is inventory of restoredBundle
restoredEquip is equipment of restoredBundle

if name of restoredHero is not "Sir Galahad"
    fail with "deserializeGameState failed: restored name mismatch"
.
if level of restoredHero is not 2
    fail with "deserializeGameState failed: restored level mismatch"
.
if getEquipmentAttackBonus restoredEquip is not 20
    fail with "deserializeGameState failed: restored equipment attack mismatch"
.
if getEquipmentDefenseBonus restoredEquip is not 15
    fail with "deserializeGameState failed: restored equipment defense mismatch"
.

# 12. Bug 5 Test: reviveActor with 0 HP must not revive actor
fallen is createActor "Fallen Knight" 50 1
applyDamage fallen 50
if isAlive of fallen is not false
    fail with "fallen actor expected dead"
.
reviveZeroRes is reviveActor fallen 0
if reviveZeroRes is not 0
    fail with "reviveActor with 0 HP must return 0"
.
if isAlive of fallen is not false
    fail with "actor must remain dead when revived with 0 HP"
.
if health of fallen is not 0
    fail with "dead actor HP must remain 0"
.

# 13. Bug 4 Test: Multi-leveling in gainExperience (500 XP at 100/level -> level 6)
novice is createActor "Novice Mage" 60 1
multiLvlOk is gainExperience novice 500 100
if multiLvlOk is not true
    fail with "gainExperience failed to trigger multi-leveling"
.
if level of novice is not 6
    fail with "multi-leveling expected level 6 from 500 XP at 100/level"
.
if experience of novice is not 0
    fail with "multi-leveling expected 0 leftover experience"
.

# 14. Bug 2 & 3 Test: Accessory equipping, attack/defense bonuses, and savegame persistence
accEquip is createEquipment
fireRing is createItem "Ring of Fire" "attack_accessory" 12
wardPendant is createItem "Pendant of Warding" "defense_accessory" 8

equipFireOk is equipItem accEquip fireRing
if equipFireOk is not true
    fail with "failed to equip attack_accessory into accessory slot"
.
atkWithAcc is getEquipmentAttackBonus accEquip
if atkWithAcc is not 12
    fail with "attack_accessory bonus failed: expected 12"
.

equipWardOk is equipItem accEquip wardPendant
if equipWardOk is not true
    fail with "failed to equip defense_accessory into accessory slot"
.
defWithAcc is getEquipmentDefenseBonus accEquip
if defWithAcc is not 8
    fail with "defense_accessory bonus failed: expected 8"
.

# Save and restore accessory slot
accSavedState is serializeGameState novice bag accEquip
accRestoredBundle is deserializeGameState accSavedState
accRestoredEquip is equipment of accRestoredBundle
restoredDefAcc is getEquipmentDefenseBonus accRestoredEquip
if restoredDefAcc is not 8
    fail with "restored accessory defense bonus mismatch: expected 8"
.
restoredAccItem is accessory of accRestoredEquip
if itemName of restoredAccItem is not "Pendant of Warding"
    fail with "restored accessory itemName mismatch: expected Pendant of Warding"
.
if itemKind of restoredAccItem is not "defense_accessory"
    fail with "restored accessory itemKind mismatch: expected defense_accessory"
.

# 15. Bug 1 Test: Runtime Scoping & Variable Clash Safety
# Callers can have variables named b, inv, eq, item without clashing with library internal variables
inv is "caller_inv_string"
eq is "caller_eq_string"
item is "caller_item_string"
b is createInventory 3
c is createInventory 4

if inv is not "caller_inv_string"
    fail with "caller inv variable was corrupted by library call"
.
if eq is not "caller_eq_string"
    fail with "caller eq variable was corrupted by library call"
.
if item is not "caller_item_string"
    fail with "caller item variable was corrupted by library call"
.
if capacity of b is not 3
    fail with "first created inventory capacity mismatch"
.
if capacity of c is not 4
    fail with "second created inventory capacity mismatch"
.

say "All game-entity behavioral tests passed successfully!"

    _lu_idx is 1
    _lu_endIdx is startIndex plus countLimit
    for each _lu_it in items

# math-utils - Otter Reusable Math Library
# Provides clamp, lerp, mapRange, minVal, maxVal, calcAverage, calcSum, calcPercentage, roundVal, roundUpVal, roundDownVal
# Internal variables use '_mu_' prefix to prevent collisions with caller/outer variables.

to clamp value minLimit maxLimit
    _mu_low is minLimit
    _mu_high is maxLimit
    if _mu_low is greater than _mu_high
        _mu_temp is _mu_low
        _mu_low is _mu_high
        _mu_high is _mu_temp
    .
    if value is less than _mu_low
        return _mu_low
    .
    if value is greater than _mu_high
        return _mu_high
    .
    return value
.

to lerp startVal endVal t
    _mu_diff is endVal minus startVal
    _mu_offset is _mu_diff times t
    return startVal plus _mu_offset
.

to mapRange val inMin inMax outMin outMax
    _mu_inSpan is inMax minus inMin
    if _mu_inSpan is 0
        return outMin
    .
    _mu_outSpan is outMax minus outMin
    _mu_valDelta is val minus inMin
    _mu_fraction is _mu_valDelta divided by _mu_inSpan
    _mu_scaled is _mu_fraction times _mu_outSpan
    return outMin plus _mu_scaled
.

to minVal left right
    if left is less than right
        return left
    .
    return right
.

to maxVal left right
    if left is greater than right
        return left
    .
    return right
.

to calcAverage items
    _mu_total is 0
    _mu_count is 0
    for each _mu_it in items
        _mu_total is _mu_total plus _mu_it
        _mu_count is _mu_count plus 1
    .
    if _mu_count is 0
        return 0
    .
    return _mu_total divided by _mu_count
.

to calcSum items
    _mu_total is 0
    for each _mu_it in items
        _mu_total is _mu_total plus _mu_it
    .
    return _mu_total
.

to calcPercentage part whole
    if whole is 0
        return 0
    .
    _mu_fraction is part divided by whole
    return _mu_fraction times 100
.

to roundVal val
    return round of val
.

to roundUpVal val
    return round up of val
.

to roundDownVal val
    return round down of val
.

# Provides repeatText, padLeft, padRight, slugify, toUpper, toLower,
# isEqualIgnoreCase, isNonEmpty, replaceText, containsText, startsWithText,
# endsWithText, splitText, joinText, and normalizeSpaces
# Internal variables use '_tu_' prefix to prevent collisions with caller/outer variables.

to repeatText src timesCount
    if timesCount is at most 0
        return ""
    .
    _tu_result is ""
    count from 1 to timesCount as _tu_idx
        _tu_result is _tu_result plus src
    .
    return _tu_result
.

to padLeft text targetLen padChar
    _tu_curLen is length of text
    if _tu_curLen is at least targetLen
        return text
    .
    _tu_needed is targetLen minus _tu_curLen
    _tu_padding is repeatText padChar _tu_needed
    return _tu_padding plus text
.

to padRight text targetLen padChar
    _tu_curLen is length of text
    if _tu_curLen is at least targetLen
        return text
    .
    _tu_needed is targetLen minus _tu_curLen
    _tu_padding is repeatText padChar _tu_needed
    return text plus _tu_padding
.

to normalizeSpaces text
    split text by " " into _tu_parts
    _tu_valid are empty
    for each _tu_p in _tu_parts
        if length of _tu_p is greater than 0
            add _tu_p to _tu_valid
        .
    .
    join _tu_valid with " " into _tu_trimmed
    return _tu_trimmed
.

to slugify text
    _tu_clean is lowercase of text
    replace "." with "" in _tu_clean
    replace "," with "" in _tu_clean
    replace "!" with "" in _tu_clean
    replace "?" with "" in _tu_clean
    replace ":" with "" in _tu_clean
    replace ";" with "" in _tu_clean
    replace "(" with "" in _tu_clean

    replace "-" with " " in _tu_clean
    _tu_norm is normalizeSpaces _tu_clean

to toLower text

    .
    return false

        return false
    .
    if length of text is 0
        return false
    .
    return true

    return false

    .
    return false
.

    return _tu_parts
.

components.description: Desktop contact management application with input validation and file-backed persistence.

preview.caption: The recipe defines a custom `Contact` type and combines `otter-official/text-utils` with structural string scanning to validate email format `@` and `.`. Valid entries are appended to a persistent list.
architecture: validate-input: Perform email address structure and non-empty name assertions (otter-official/text-utils)
persist-contacts: Save validated contact cards into JSON storage (otter-official/file-helpers)

files.content:
# ==============================================================================
# Generated by Otter Application Recipe: contact-manager 1.0.0
# Target: Contact Manager Application with File Persistence & Validation
# ==============================================================================

use "${import:otter-official/file-helpers}"
use "${import:otter-official/text-utils}"

a Contact has
    id
    name
    email
    phone
.

to validateEmail emailAddress
    if emailAddress is ""
        return false
    .
    if not emailAddress contains "@"
        return false
    .
    if not emailAddress contains "."
        return false
    .
    split emailAddress by "@" into atParts
    atCount is length of atParts
    if atCount is not 2
        return false
    .
    domain is last of atParts
    split domain by "." into domainParts
    dotCount is length of domainParts
    if dotCount is at least 2
        return true
    .
    return false
.

to createContact cid name email phone
    if not validateEmail email
        say "Error: Invalid email format for contact: "
        say email
        return gone
    .
    c is a Contact
    id of c is cid
    name of c is name
    email of c is email
    phone of c is phone
    return c
.

to searchContacts contacts term
    matches are empty
    for each c in contacts
        cName is name of c
        if cName contains term
            add c to matches
        .
    .
    return matches
.

to editContactPhone contacts targetId newPhone
    updated are empty
    for each c in contacts
        cid is id of c
        if cid is targetId
            phone of c is newPhone
        .
        add c to updated
    .
    return updated
.

to deleteContact contacts targetId
    remaining are empty
    for each c in contacts
        cid is id of c
        if cid is not targetId
            add c to remaining
        .
    .
    return remaining
.

to displayContacts contacts titleText
    say "=== " plus titleText plus " ==="
    countVal is length of contacts
    if countVal is 0
        say "(No contacts found)"
        return false
    .
    for each c in contacts
        cid is id of c
        cName is name of c
        cEmail is email of c
        cPhone is phone of c
        namePadded is padRight cName 18 " "
        emailPadded is padRight cEmail 24 " "
        lineParts are
            "#"
            cid
            ": "
            namePadded
            " | "
            emailPadded
            " | "
            cPhone
        .
        join lineParts with "" into line
        say line
    .
    return true
.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Storage operations
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to saveContactsToFile contacts filePath
    convert contacts to json into rawJson
    writeSafe filePath rawJson
    return true
.

to loadContactsFromFile filePath
    raw is readOrFallback filePath "[]"
    loaded is a thing
    convert raw from json into loaded
    return loaded
.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main Application Execution
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
storeFile is "contacts_store.json"

# Load saved contacts or initialize default directory
directory is loadContactsFromFile storeFile
dirLen is length of directory

if dirLen is 0
    say "Initializing new contact directory: ${config:companyBookName}"
    c1 is createContact 1 "Ada Lovelace" "ada@analytical.org" "555-0101"
    if c1 is not gone
        add c1 to directory
    .
    c2 is createContact 2 "Charles Babbage" "charles@engines.org" "555-0102"
    if c2 is not gone
        add c2 to directory
    .
    c3 is createContact 3 "Alan Turing" "alan@bletchley.uk" "555-0103"
    if c3 is not gone
        add c3 to directory
    .
    saveContactsToFile directory storeFile
.

displayContacts directory "${config:companyBookName}"
say "Active contact count:"
say length of directory

    email

    timestamp

    .
    if not email contains "@"
        return false
    .
    if not email contains "."
        return false
    .
    if message is ""
        return false
    .
    return true

    email of s is email
    message of s is message

    return s
.

to saveSubmissions list filePath
    convert list to json into rawJson
    writeSafe filePath rawJson
    return true
.

    return loaded
.

to getNavigation
    nav are empty
    add "Home" to nav
    add "Submissions API" to nav
    add "Contact" to nav
    return nav
.

# Web server declaration (Executed when started via `otter serve`)
site is a web server
    port is ${config:portNumber}
    host is "127.0.0.1"
    static is "public"
.

when site receives GET at "/api/nav"
    nav is getNavigation
    respond with nav as json
.

when site receives GET at "/api/submissions"

    respond with subs as json
.

when site receives POST at "/api/submit" into req
    bodyData is a thing
    convert body of req from json into bodyData
    subName is name of bodyData
    subEmail is email of bodyData
    subMsg is message of bodyData
    if validateSubmission subName subEmail subMsg
        newSub is createSubmission subName subEmail subMsg
        currentSubs is loadSubmissions "submissions_store.json"
        add newSub to currentSubs
        saveSubmissions currentSubs "submissions_store.json"
        respond with newSub as json and status 201
    otherwise
        err has
            error is "Validation failed: invalid name, email, or message"
        .
        respond with err as json and status 400
    .
.

preview.caption: Zero-dependency Otter 1.0.1 snippet (Validation & Errors). Copy the parameterized template or run the self-contained example.
architecture: Zero external pack dependencies — paste directly into any .ot file

files.label: template.ot
files.content:
to validateEmail email
    if email contains "@"
        split email by "@" into parts
        if length of parts is 2
            userPart is first of parts
            domainPart is last of parts
            if length of userPart is greater than 0
                if domainPart contains "."
                    return true
                .
            .
        .
    .
    return false
.

files.content:
to validateEmail email
    if email contains "@"
        split email by "@" into parts
        if length of parts is 2
            userPart is first of parts
            domainPart is last of parts
            if length of userPart is greater than 0
                if domainPart contains "."
                    return true
                .
            .
        .
    .
    return false
.

okEmail is validateEmail "dev@otter.org"
badEmail is validateEmail "invalid-email"

say "Check dev@otter.org:" okEmail
say "Check invalid-email:" badEmail

if okEmail is not true
    fail with "validateEmail rejected valid email dev@otter.org"
.
if badEmail is not false
    fail with "validateEmail accepted invalid email invalid-email"
.

    host is "127.0.0.1"
.

when site receives GET at "${path}"
    payload has
        status is "ok"
    .
    respond with payload as json
.

files.label: example.ot
files.content:
site is a web server
    port is 18090
    host is "127.0.0.1"
.

when site receives GET at "/health"
    payload has
        status is "healthy"
        uptime is "active"
    .
    respond with payload as json

components.description: Execute statements repeatedly while a condition evaluates to true.

files.label: template.ot
example.ot
files.content:
counter is 3
while counter is greater than 0
    say "Countdown:" counter
    decrease counter
.

if counter is not 0
    fail with "while-loop termination mismatch: expected 0"
.
